resources.string: Reads only the background screen an agent is working on, never the screen you are using.
Start it so agents can operate this phone
Sign in below to reach it from other networks
Agents can operate this phone now
Before an agent uses your apps
Please read these four points. They are the real risks, not boilerplate.
Many apps\' terms forbid third-party tools from operating them automatically. Using Miu Bridge in such an app can get your account restricted or closed.
Agents act on your instructions, in your accounts. What they do there is your responsibility.
Do not have an agent pay, transfer money, place orders or delete data. Payment and banking apps are blocked.
The first time an agent wants to use an app with an account, this phone asks you. You decide app by app.
The terms of %1$s may forbid automated use by third-party tools; your account there could be restricted or closed. Allow only if you accept that.
Ask me before a new app
Agents wait for your OK the first time they open an app with an account
You have allowed %1$d apps so far
Agents work on a hidden second screen. The phone needs two switches turned on for that, once.
No wireless debugging on this phone?
Some phones (HarmonyOS, Android 10 and earlier) have no wireless debugging. A computer can open the same door with one command.
On the phone, turn on USB debugging in Developer options.
Connect the phone to a computer with a cable, and tap Allow when the phone asks. The computer needs adb (Android platform-tools, a free download from Google).
Unplug the cable and tap Done below. When the phone asks to allow debugging once more, allow it.
This lasts until the phone restarts; after a restart, run the command again.
Miu Bridge is creating the background screen. If the phone asks whether to allow debugging, allow it.
Choose where your agent runs, then copy the instructions and send them to it: Claude Code, Codex, Muse, Instinct or any other.
The agent can be anywhere. This needs a free account so it can find your phone.
The agent is on the same Wi-Fi as this phone. No account needed.
Say this to your agent. When it acts on the phone, you will see it here.
Use Miu Bridge to open Settings on my phone and tell me the battery level.
Nothing shows on your screen while it works; it uses the background screen.
Connected. Your agent just used this phone.
Keeps working with the screen off
So it returns after a reboot
Works with any agent on any device: Claude Code, Codex, Muse, Instinct and more.
Sign in to connect from other networks. On the same Wi-Fi no account is needed.

Send the full text to any agent: it holds the address, the token and both ways to use the phone (as an MCP server, or from scripts in the agent\'s own sandbox; the agent decides). If the agent then asks you to put the token in its credential store, come back and copy just the token.
Copied. Send it to your agent.
The token is the key to this phone. Give it only to agents you trust.
Sign in with your email so agents on other networks can reach this phone. The first sign-in creates your account.
Tap to open the download page

Send anonymous usage data from tool calls on this phone: which tool, which app, whether it worked, the error code, and how long it took. It helps us find where agents get stuck. You can change this at any time in More.
Never sent: what is on the screen, screenshots, anything typed, links, your account or email. A random id is used instead of your account, and leaving deletes what was sent.
Anonymous usage data, never screen content or typed text. Turning it off deletes what was sent.
Remote calls this month: %1$d / %2$d · same Wi-Fi is not counted
This month\'s %2$d remote calls are used up (%1$d). Same Wi-Fi still works.
Agents on other networks will lose access. Signing in again with the same email keeps the same address.
Screen stays dim and never locks; uses battery
Slower in apps with accounts, to avoid being flagged
Give it tasks right here, no other device needed
The old token stops working at once
The old token stops working at once. Every connected agent needs the new connection details.

The relay lets agents on other networks reach this phone. Leave it empty for the hosted one, or enter the address of a relay you run yourself. Changing it signs this phone out.
This phone\'s sign-in is no longer valid. Sign in again.
Can\'t reach this phone\'s debugging yet. Do “Pair wireless debugging” in Setup (Android 11+, on Wi-Fi, no computer).
Debugging wasn\'t allowed. Tap Retry and choose Allow on the prompt. If no prompt appears, turn USB debugging off and on in Developer options, then tap Retry.

Tap Allow on the USB debugging prompt and tick “Always allow”. Don\'t dismiss it: it only shows once.
Waiting for an agent · background screen ready
Allow notifications first: the pairing code is typed into one
In Wireless debugging tap “Pair device with pairing code”, then pull down the notifications and type the 6-digit code here
Looking for this phone\'s pairing service
Make sure Wi-Fi is on and the pairing code window is still open, then type the code again
Check the 6 digits in the pairing window and type them again
Close the pairing window, tap “Pair device with pairing code” again and retype the code
After a reboot the app reconnects by itself
